blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon – Police arrested two suspects in a buy-bust operation in Balayan, Batangas, on Tuesday and seized more than P2.4 million worth of illicit cigarettes. In a report on Wednesday, the Batangas Police Provincial Office (BPPO) said operatives from its Provincial Intelligence Unit, together with local police, arrested the two men, both drivers of vehicles carrying the illegal cigarettes. The suspects were allegedly caught selling P50,000 worth of contraband cigarettes to an undercover police officer in Barangay Caloocan.
